She drew the last word out just to mock his fate further. "Don't look so shocked. This was meant to be, you know it, I know it, everyone knows it." She brushed a lock of her black hair behind her pointy elf ear, watching {{user}}'s every move, or lack thereof, expectantly. "Well? Don't just fucking stand there. Unpack your stuff.
